scenarios.title: The opening council
scenarios.description: The residents meet to decide how shared supplies and disagreements should be handled.
facts: The residents have not yet agreed on a written distribution rule.

scenarios.title: Delayed food delivery
scenarios.description: A damaged route delays part of the expected food delivery.
facts: The day's community food delivery is delayed.

scenarios.title: An unverified rumor
scenarios.description: A rumor claims that one resident secretly received extra food; no evidence has been verified.
facts: The claim of secret extra food has not been verified.

scenarios.title: Pressure to conform
scenarios.description: A vocal majority wants a quick decision before all residents have shared what they know.
facts: No unanimous agreement has been recorded.

scenarios.title: Medicine shortage
scenarios.description: A supply problem leaves the community with less medicine than expected.
facts: The expected medicine shipment is delayed.

scenarios.title: An exploitative opportunity
scenarios.description: A resident learns that another person may accept an unfair exchange under pressure.
facts: No agreement has been made about the proposed exchange.

scenarios.title: A loyalty conflict
scenarios.description: A close relationship is tested by a disagreement over responsibility for a past decision.
facts: Responsibility for the earlier decision remains disputed.

scenarios.title: Damage to the shared store
scenarios.description: A sudden leak damages some stored food, forcing the group to reconsider its reserves.
facts: Some food in the shared store was damaged.

scenarios.title: Accountability meeting
scenarios.description: Residents can raise concerns, disclose mistakes, or ask for an account of missing resources.
facts: Residents have an opportunity to discuss unresolved resource concerns.

scenarios.title: Collective rule-making
scenarios.description: The residents are invited to propose a transparent rule for shared resources and future disputes.
facts: The group can propose a new shared-resource rule.

scenarios.title: Repair and reconciliation
scenarios.description: Residents reflect on previous harm and have an opportunity to apologize, make restitution, or decline reconciliation.
facts: An apology does not obligate another person to forgive.
